svg.title: Five of six agent memory types collapse into three storage tiers, and working memory is the bottleneck all of them feed.
svg.desc: Short-term memory becomes hot memory, the checkpoint for the current thread. Episodic and semantic memory become cold memory, recall across threads. Document memory keeps project knowledge in files. Procedural memory sits outside all three tiers, in the system prompt and tool definitions. Working memory, grouped with the hot tier, is the point of the figure: it is the bounded context window every tier ultimately loads into.
